scripts.setup:android: npm run vendor && npx cap add android && npm run assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: node tests/upload-engine.mock.mjs > /dev/null && node tests/upload-engine.scenarios.mock.mjs && python3 tests/list-entries.py > tests/.entries.json && node tests/zip-manager.mock.mjs tests/.entries.json
